operator_notes: H1 open-loop manual DAC sweep using the new dirty-to-clean power path for the CX317. Primary comparison is against run_013: CNT validity, PPS sanity, dropped records, DAC response repeatability, and any supply-induced warmup or noise behavior. No closed-loop steering.

control_path.network: AD5693R output through existing series resistor to CX317 pin 4 Vc

power_path.bench_notes: Record exact dirty source, clean node, filter/regulator parts, grounding, startup behavior, and measurement bandwidth before capture.

conditioning.oscillator_output_conditioner: CX317 powered through new dirty-to-clean path; record whether FC0 observation path remains as run_013 or changed for this run

control_sequence: manual open-loop DAC sweep only; no PPS-derived or FC0-derived steering
known_limitations: H1 open-loop characterization only. No closed-loop GPSDO steering is implemented or implied.
Power-path fields are explicit nulls or empty strings until measured on the bench.
This run characterizes the new CX317 dirty-to-clean power path and should not be mixed with earlier power-path data without noting the topology change.
The pre-G17-fix capture is preserved under derived/pre_g17_fix_capture_2026-07-25/ as negative hardware evidence and is excluded from the clean post-fix plant fit.
REF/PPS cadence anomalies are explicitly gated as diagnostic-only unresolved reference/capture-path evidence; anomalous REF rows remain in csv/ref.csv and are not control-eligible.

pps_cadence.evidence: Short REF/PPS intervals occur in 16 clusters early in the capture, including a dense burst from about 1692.806 s to 1796.805 s elapsed. They are not startup-only because capture begins around firmware uptime 691 s and the last anomaly is around 1916.805 s elapsed. Capture transport counters stayed at zero drops/errors and the run has one host session, but current firmware does not emit source/capture-path counters sufficient to distinguish GPS/PPS source, GPIO, IRQ, FIFO, DMA, or firmware-path extra-edge causes.
